_comment: Firecrawl is the fallback layer, for careers pages no API covers.
Every other source is a free official API or feed; this one costs credits,
so it is pointed at a named list rather than turned loose on a crawl.
Add a company here when: it has a careers page, it is NOT on Greenhouse /
Lever / Ashby / Keka (run `probe_keka` and `probe_ats` first - they are
free), and it has no RSS or JSON feed. Firecrawl renders the page including
JS and returns markdown, which scoring and contact extraction read.
The API key lives in .push-credentials (gitignored) as FIRECRAWL_API_KEY.
It is never committed and the deploy script refuses to ship any file

limits._comment: One page per entry per run. 500 free credits is ~500 page renders, so at 6-hourly runs keep this list short.

targets._why: Kept as a known-good target: this page reliably lists openings, so a run with 0 results means something broke rather than 'nothing is hiring'.
Already in the tracker with an HR inbox; not on any ATS we probe.
Seed company, Mahadevapura. No ATS board found.
One of very few Lucknow dev shops in the tracker.
